answer: The filler tops the cask with the funnel, and the top must run to the brim without spilling a drop. Barrel willow stave moulder elm bond governs the topping: a bond willow stave moulders lodge after moulding bench checks. First comes the pearl, topped at the vat; then the umber, topped before the cask is sealed; the yarrow is the seal itself, waxed and tight. A counterfeiter faces 23 false tops and 23 false seals.
